status: inert historical reference; do not execute or enable
content:
name: Backfill tagged zh-CN Linux packages
'on':
  push:
    branches: [release/backfill-zh-linux]
    paths: [.github/workflows/zh-linux-backfill.yml, scripts/release-backfill/**]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: zh-linux-backfill
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.tag }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    container: ${{ matrix.image }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        tag: [v3.18.0-zh.1, v3.18.0-zh.2]
        target: [appimage, '24.04', bookworm, trixie]
        include:
          - tag: v3.18.0-zh.1
            sha: 48d321f908d503cb90dacb1368998918fc48b14b
          - tag: v3.18.0-zh.2
            sha: de2821269e4fa138ff88dd5e856b111cc4942ee9
          - target: appimage
            runner: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            image: ubuntu:22.04
          - target: '24.04'
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
          - target: bookworm
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: debian:bookworm
          - target: trixie
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: debian:trixie
    env:
      SOURCE_TAG: ${{ matrix.tag }}
      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.sha }}
      TARGET_DISTRO: ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
      - name: Bootstrap checkout
        run: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git ca-certificates
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.tag }}
          path: source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build and test unchanged release source
        working-directory: source
        shell: bash
        run: bash ../automation/scripts/release-backfill/build.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: package-${{ matrix.tag }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: source/output/*
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Preserve build acceptance evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-evidence-${{ matrix.tag }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: source/acceptance/
          if-no-files-found: warn
  verify:
    name: Clean runtime ${{ matrix.tag }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    needs: build
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    container: ${{ matrix.image }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        tag: [v3.18.0-zh.1, v3.18.0-zh.2]
        target: [appimage, '24.04', bookworm, trixie]
        include:
          - tag: v3.18.0-zh.1
            sha: 48d321f908d503cb90dacb1368998918fc48b14b
          - tag: v3.18.0-zh.2
            sha: de2821269e4fa138ff88dd5e856b111cc4942ee9
          - target: appimage
            runner: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            image: ubuntu:22.04
          - target: '24.04'
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
          - target: bookworm
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: debian:bookworm
          - target: trixie
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: debian:trixie
    env:
      SOURCE_TAG: ${{ matrix.tag }}
      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.sha }}
      TARGET_DISTRO: ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
      - name: Bootstrap checkout
        run: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git ca-certificates
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.sha }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: package-${{ matrix.tag }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: source/artifacts
      - name: Verify package in clean runtime
        working-directory: source
        shell: bash
        run: bash ../automation/scripts/release-backfill/verify.sh
      - name: Preserve clean runtime evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: runtime-evidence-${{ matrix.tag }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: source/acceptance/
          if-no-files-found: warn
  publish:
    name: Append four packages to ${{ matrix.tag }}
    needs: [build, verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - tag: v3.18.0-zh.1
            sha: 48d321f908d503cb90dacb1368998918fc48b14b
          - tag: v3.18.0-zh.2
            sha: de2821269e4fa138ff88dd5e856b111cc4942ee9
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: package-${{ matrix.tag }}-*
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Append verified assets and checksums without replacing existing files
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SOURCE_TAG: ${{ matrix.tag }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.sha }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: python3 scripts/release-backfill/publish.py
